acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc:
At the announcement of New York City’s inaugural rat czar, we meet Darneice Foster, who despises the rats outside her apartment. And host Ira Glass introduces two special co-hosts for today’s show.
Rats performed throughout the show by Bashir Salahuddin and Chandra Russell.
acts.credits: By Ira Glass; Produced by Valerie Kipnis and Emmanuel Dzotsi

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Producer Elna Baker meets Todd Sklar, a man who can’t quit rats.
acts.title: Fifty First Rats

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Fifty years ago, New York City started to put garbage out in plastic bags. This has become the number one food source for rats. Producer Ike Sriskandarajah investigates the decision that led to the city’s rat baby boom.
acts.title: The Big Bag Theory

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: How did Alberta, Canada pull off a feat that has eluded the rest of human civilization? Ira visits the largest rat-less land in the world.
acts.credits: By Ira Glass; Produced by Alaa Mostafa
acts.title: Alberta? More Like I’ll-Murdah…A-Lotta Rats

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc:
We drop a hot mic into a hot mess of a rats’ nest. You’ll never believe what happens next.
Rats performed by Chris Gethard and Tami Sagher.
acts.title: Put That Down, You Can’t Eat That
